title: Workflow
description: A high-level workflow: a graph of task intents. Each task references a task_type defined in the task_types/ catalog; a task's `inputs` are open here and validated out-of-band against the matching catalog entry's `inputsSchema`.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this workflow does.

tasks.description: The tasks that make up the workflow, wired together via each task's `next`.

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the task within this workflow. Referenced by other tasks' `next`.

task_type.description: Name of the task type. Resolves to a catalog entry in task_types/<task_type>.json, which defines the required inputs.

inputs.description: Business-level inputs to the task. Open here; validated out-of-band against the task_type catalog entry's `inputsSchema`. Values may be any JSON type.

outputs.description: Outputs produced by the task, referenceable by downstream tasks. Open here; validated against the catalog entry's `outputsSchema` when present.

next.description: task_id(s) to execute after this one. Empty array denotes a terminal task.
